The box is subjected to an upward normal force F_Normal, a downward gravitational force F_g, and a horizontal leftward friction force F_friction. For an object sliding on a stationary horizontal surface, the direction of kinetic friction is always opposite to the direction of the object's motion relative to the contact surface. Because the friction force in the figure is to the left, the box must be moving to the right relative to the ground.
